chunks: Whoever applies a depilatory substance and massages himself with henna from his head to his feet, Allah removes poverty from him.

key_terms.اطَّلَى: applied a depilatory substance to the body
key_terms.رُوِيَ: it is narrated; a report transmitted without mentioning a full sanad/isnad here

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about using depilatory treatment and henna in relation to poverty?
ai.summary: This hadith states that a person who uses a depilatory substance and rubs himself with henna from head to foot is granted removal of poverty by Allah. It highlights cleanliness and bodily care as practices associated with divine blessing and wellbeing.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.271 - It is narrated (from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah) that he narrates:
"Whoever applies a depilatory substance and massages himself with henna from head to toe, Allah (swt) removes poverty from him."
